sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:76

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:76:1
items.html:
Adam HaRishon was created by the coupling of ZON, who rose up into the chamber of AVI, and there they coupled face to face and bore Adam and Eve: Know that the NRN [Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama] of the righteous are from the internality of the three worlds BYA: the Nefesh from Assiya, the Ruach from Yetzira, and the Neshama from Beria. And therefore all the souls of the righteous are emanated by the coupling of ZON of Atzilut, for the world of Beria is the offspring of the world of Atzilut.
And by this you will understand that Adam HaRishon, who included all the souls of the righteous in the world, was born by the coupling of ZON of Atzilut. But since ZON were then still in the aspect of back to back, as above (page 628, the passage beginning “And After”) — for no Partzuf attains its aspect of face to face, except after the emanation of its lower one, for then the lower one rises to MAN and returns to the upper one face to face — see there the whole continuation. And therefore, before Adam HaRishon was born, who is the lower one of ZON of Atzilut, there was no possibility that ZON would be face to face. It is also known that there is no coupling in a Partzuf that can beget a lower degree, unless it is face to face. And moreover, even AVI were still in the aspect of face to back, as above (page 628, the passage beginning “And After”), see there. And therefore ZON rose into the chamber of AVI and were there as MAN for AVI, and AVI were returned face to face by the inclusion of ZON within them, and from this coupling came out the soul of Adam HaRishon.
And one should understand two matters here: for in truth it is regarded as a coupling of AVI, since they are the ones who make the coupling, as explained. But since they made their coupling upon the MAN of ZON, therefore the coupling is regarded like the coupling of ZON, and it is found that Adam HaRishon is only the offspring of ZON and not the offspring of AVI.
And we must understand well the matter of these MAN that ZON raised for the sake of the birth of the soul of Adam HaRishon. And it was already explained above (page 624, the passage beginning “And with this you will understand”) that there are three aspects, one below the other, in the sortings of BON:
The choicest of them all is what came out in the Katnut of Nekudim, and Atik took them. Phase two is what came out there by the breath of the Tabur, which is the aspect of face to back of AVI and Keter, from which came out AA, AVI, and ZON in the aspect of Ruach Nefesh. And the worst of them all is what came out there by the MAN of the Vav and the point of the Yesod of AK, which illuminated in AVI. Study it there well.
And you find that ZON, which were now corrected by AVI, no longer had anything of the Vav and the point in them. And the reason for this is that everything goes according to the order of the degree, and every Partzuf can sort out only what belongs to its degree, as written well above (page 626, the passage beginning “And Arich”), see there the whole continuation. And therefore AVI could not sort out the degrees that came out on the Vav and the point, because they do not belong to their aspect; but they reached them in the aspect of MAN from the NHY of AK, and the degree of AVI is drawn from the light of the Einayim of SAG of AK, as this was written well above in Part 6. And therefore AVI sorted out only the aspect of ZON that came out from the light of the Einayim of SAG, from the aspect of the look of the eyes upon the AHP, which is the aspect of the faces of ZON; but nothing of the aspect of the Vav and the point, with which AVI have no connection whatsoever, as explained.
But after ZON were corrected in the aspects of their faces, then ZON sorted out also the aspects of their posterior, which are the aspects of the Vav and the point, which are the aspects of the Gadlut of the seven kings, as is known. And you already know what the ARI said: that from the aspects of the vessels, the Gadlut is called by the name posterior, and the Katnut that came out at the beginning of Atzilut is called by the name faces; for the Katnut is the aspect of GE, and the Gadlut is the aspect of AHP. And therefore the MAN of the Vav and the point are called by the name posterior. And there is another reason: for the Katnut of ZON did not expand to BYA, but the Mochin of the Vav and the point expanded to BYA at the time of their reign, as is known. And it is now explained that the MAN that ZON sorted out for the sake of the soul of Adam HaRishon were from the aspect of their posterior from the time of the kings, namely, from the aspect of the Vav and the point. And from these MAN came out the soul of Adam HaRishon.
And these sortings of the soul of Adam HaRishon were from below upward: at first ZON sorted out the aspect of the MAN related to the aspect of Neshama, and afterwards, from the MAN related to the aspect of Haya, and afterwards, to the aspect of Yechida. As written before us, for the choicest of all was sorted out first. And therefore, at first phase two was sorted out, which is Neshama, and afterwards phase three, which is Haya, and afterwards phase four, which is Yechida.
And it was already explained above (page 659, the passage beginning “However”) the great difference between these Mochin that came out on the MAN of the Vav and the point and the previous Mochin that came out on the MAN of the two first phases: for the previous Mochin are fixed in Atzilut, and their coupling never ceases forever; not so these Mochin that came out on the MAN of the Vav and the point — their coupling ceases, and they are not fixed at all, but they are in ascent and descent according to the deeds of their lower ones. And not only the soul of Adam HaRishon itself, but even the Mochin that came out for its sake in the upper Partzufim of Atzilut are likewise in ascent and descent, like the soul of Adam HaRishon itself, as written before us.

items.html:
The head of Adam HaRishon was then in the world of Beria, which is now the place of ZA of Atzilut, etc.: And the reason for this is that since ZON rose and stood in the place of AVI, the coupling is regarded like the coupling of AVI themselves, whose body is ZON. And therefore, after the completion of the coupling in AVI, the level descended to the aspect of the Chazeh of ZA: from the Chazeh and upward, to the Malchut of AVI, came out the ten Sefirot of the head of the soul of Adam HaRishon; and the ten Sefirot from above downward, namely the body of the soul, came out from the Chazeh of ZA and below, to the very end of Assiya, which was then above the world of Assiya of now, namely, to the Chazeh of Yetzira, for from the Chazeh of Yetzira and below was then the place of the shells, since the mixing of the holiness in the shells had not yet occurred.
And we must know here well the matter of the division of the soul, according to the three worlds BYA: for the head of the soul is the ten Sefirot of Beria; the throat of the soul is the four first Sefirot, which are KHBD of Yetzira; the body of the soul to its Chazeh is the seven lower Sefirot of Yetzira; and the two lower thirds of the Tifferet of the soul, to the end of the Tifferet, are the four first Sefirot of Assiya; and the aspects of the legs of the soul, which are its NHYM, are the seven lower Sefirot of the world of Assiya. In such a way that the Malchut of the world of Beria is the Peh of the head of the soul, and the Malchut of Yetzira is the aspect of the Chazeh of the body of the soul, and the aspect from the Chazeh and below of the soul is the world of Assiya.
And if we liken the whole level of the soul to the whole level of Atzilut: the ten Sefirot of Beria, namely the head of the soul, are found to resemble the aspect of the Rosh of AA; and the four first Sefirot of Yetzira, namely the throat of the soul, resemble the throat of AA, which is the Keter of AVI of Atzilut; and the seven lower Sefirot of Yetzira, which are the HGT of the soul to the Chazeh, resemble the HGT of AA to the Chazeh, and the AVI that clothe them there; and the four first Sefirot of Assiya, which are the two lower thirds of the Tifferet of the soul, resemble YESHSUT and the Keter of ZA, which clothe the two lower thirds of the Tifferet of AA; and the seven lower Sefirot of Assiya, which are the legs of the soul, resemble the ZON of Atzilut, which clothe the legs of AA, namely, its NHYM.
And this is what he says: “For the head of Adam HaRishon was then in the world of Beria, which is now the place of ZA of Atzilut, and his throat was in the first four of Yetzira, which is now the place of the Nukva of Atzilut” — for it was explained that after the completion of the coupling of the level of the soul in the chamber of AVI, it descended from there to its place in the body, to the place of the Chazeh of ZON, and the ten Sefirot of the head of the soul came out from the Chazeh of ZA and upward, to the Malchut of AVI, as above. Also you know that the head of the soul is the ten Sefirot of Beria; hence the ten Sefirot of Beria stand in the place of ZA, from the Chazeh and upward. And the aspect of the throat of the soul, which is the first four of Yetzira, which is the aspect of the Keter of the body, has the relation of the Nukva of the head, as is known, from the secret of the coupling of Neshikin [kissing], which is the coupling of the palate and the throat: the Malchut of the head, called the palate, couples with the Nukva of the head, called the throat. Therefore the throat of the soul stands in the place of the Nukva of ZA. In such a way that the whole of Beria, which is the head of the soul, stands in the place of ZA, and the first four of Yetzira, which are the throat of the soul and the aspect of the Nukva of the head, stand in the place of the Nukva of ZA.
And this is what he says: “His whole body was placed in the last six of Yetzira and the first four of Assiya, which are now the measure of the place of the whole world of Beria” — namely, as above, that the Chazeh of the soul is the aspect of the Malchut of Yetzira, and the two lower thirds of the Tifferet are the first four of Assiya; hence his body includes the seven lower ones of Yetzira and the first four of Assiya. And they now stand in the place of the ten Sefirot of Beria, namely, that they are necessarily attached to the throat of the soul, which stands in the place of the Nukva of Atzilut.
And this is what he says: “And the legs of Adam HaRishon were placed in the six lower ones of the Assiya of then, which are now the six first ones of Yetzira” — namely, as above, that the seven lower ones of Assiya are the aspects of the legs of the soul, and they now end at the place of the Chazeh of Yetzira, being attached to the Malchut of Beria, which is the end of the Tifferet of the soul. As above.
